# Simpliigence AI

> Know where AI fits next. Simpliigence AI helps you prioritise, scale and see value sooner with the tools you already have, and is paid on the outcome it delivers.

Simpliigence AI helps teams prioritise, scale, reach value sooner and keep AI tied to business outcomes, using the platforms they already have. Three ways in: AI Agents (AgentBox) for growing businesses, Automation (Outcome-as-a-Service) for mid-market teams, and Simpliigence AI (Bring Your Own Intelligence) for enterprises.

## Pages
- [Home](https://simpliigence.ai/): Know where AI fits next. Simpliigence AI helps you prioritise, scale and see value sooner with the tools you already have, and is paid on the outcome it delivers.
- [Simpliigence AI](https://simpliigence.ai/ai/): Simpliigence AI delivers enterprise AI solutions on the model you already license, inside your tenant and region. AI implementation services paid at evaluation gates, then run as a managed service.
- [Automation](https://simpliigence.ai/automation/): AI workflow automation that runs a business process to an agreed KPI. We size the opportunity before you pay, and the success fee is paid only when the number moves.
- [AI Agents](https://simpliigence.ai/agents/): AI-powered business automation for small and mid-sized teams. Pick agents from a library of 36 across finance, sales, service, HR, ops and marketing. We configure, personalise and run them.
- [Industries](https://simpliigence.ai/industries/): Examples of AI in business automation across manufacturing, real estate, field services, payments, financial services and more. See the challenges we solve and the agents we recommend.
- [Resources](https://simpliigence.ai/resources/): What an AI automation platform is, how AI automation works in business, and real results from AI agents in production. Case studies and plain-English guides from Simpliigence AI.
- [Tools](https://simpliigence.ai/tools/): Free tools to find where AI would save your team the most time: an AI readiness check, a time-savings estimate and an agent picker. Results in minutes.
- [Company](https://simpliigence.ai/company/): Simpliigence AI is an AI-first company headquartered in New Jersey, with engineering in Bangalore and a 250+ person bench delivering AI technology for business across three time zones.
- [Contact](https://simpliigence.ai/contact/): Talk to a Solution Architect about AI implementation services. Book a half-day AI Health Check, a two-week Discovery Sprint or an architecture session.
